body.x: ViXS(R) Systems Showcases the XCode 4100 Series and Leading Consumer Products Utilizing XCode Family of Multimedia Processors at CES 2010
Demonstration of the Latest Multi-media Processing and Video Networking Consumer Products

TORONTO, Jan. 7 /PRNewswire/ - ViXS Systems Inc., a leader in highly innovative and advanced networked multimedia solutions will be showcasing a wide variety of ViXS based shipping consumer products at CES 2010, January 7th - 10th, at South Hall 4, Booth 36159MP. ViXS will be demonstrating the latest leading-edge Consumer Electronic (CE) products, Set Top Boxes (STB), DTVs and Blu-Ray PVR/Recorders based on their current offering of advanced XCode(R) video processing ICs. In addition to these ground breaking new consumer electronic products, ViXS will be demonstrating the latest technologies in Multimedia Processing, Video Networking and Mobile Phone support including the new XCode(R) 4100 product family.

The XCode(R) 4100 product family is an advanced media System-on-Chip ("SoC") with a powerful 1250 DMIPS application processor coupled with the ability to perform simultaneous dual HD media processing including encoding, decoding and transcoding. The XCode(R) 3000 series, an advanced MPEG4 AVC (MPEG4 Part 10/H.264) Transcoder/Encoder/Decoder System-on-a-Chip (SoC), has led the way in the CE, STB and PVR Recorder markets by being the first and only single-chip hardware transcoder shipping in all markets with leading manufacturers such as Hitachi, Sony, Sharp, Samsung, Dell and NEC.

"This will be an exciting CES 2010, especially with the new line-up of demonstrations that will be showcased at the ViXS booth this year. With a wide range of shipping products and new multimedia technologies, the ViXS booth will provide manufacturers a glimpse of what the future in multimedia processing holds," said Sally Daub, President and CEO of ViXS Systems Inc. "ViXS continues to release and showcase highly advanced Multimedia Processing SoCs which continue to be key technological innovators for leading consumer electronics manufacturers."
The following is a short list of demonstrations that will be on display in the ViXS booth at CES 2010:

- Hitachi - New Hitachi Wooo(TM) HDTVs with Built-in HDDs - Sharp - New Aquos(TM) DTV Blu-Ray Disc Recorders with Mobile Phone Support - Morega - Media Server DLNA Demonstration with Transcoding - NEC - New Wireless AirTV Broadcast Video Networking - Toshiba - New HD PVR/Recorder - TransXmedia USB Transcoder- New XCode(R) 4105 Transcoder Reference Design with Mobile Phone Support - DLNA Video Networking / XCode(R) 4115 - Dual HD Transcoding and Mobile Phone Support - Celeno/ViXS HD Wireless Video Media Gateway - ViXS DLNA Server/Client Wireless HD Networking - Entropic/ViXS DLNA - ViXS DLNA Server/Client using Entopic's MoCA Networking - AXAR(TM)/Provision - Wireless HDMI Video system - ViXS DVB-T / DVB-C PVR - XCode(R) 3290 DVB-T / DVB-C PVR Reference Design - ViXS Blu Ray Player / YouTube / Google Gadgets - XCodeHD(TM) 3390 Internet / Blu Ray Player Design - Virage Sonic Focus - Audio Enrichment Demonstration
ViXS products, solutions and technology will be on display at South Hall 4, Booth 36159MP of the Las Vegas Convention Centre in Las Vegas, NV.
